messages:
maria: incident-bot fired: synth-canary apac-east showing repeated 503s — PagerDuty page triggered (P0) :pager:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert created: synth-canary-apac-east — escalation started to rotation oncall
pagerduty-bot: Alert opened: INC-556000 (synth-canary failures)
sam: acked in PD, taking lead. quick summary: canary failures concentrated in apac-east prober fleet, seen across 10+ probes in last 2m
jordan: pulling logs from prober cluster now
lee: any user-facing errors? metric lookups?
sam: APM shows no broad 5xx spike in prod traffic. some increased latency and retries in APAC mobile traces ~0.02% above baseline
anika: looks like PD is getting duplicate alerts from each prober instance, flooding the rotation
maria: note — prober rollout v2.1 had a change to fanout default, might be the root cause (more aggressive fanout)
sam: prioritize: stop PD noise, throttle prober, check edge-proxy 429s and upstream resets
jordan: running quick commands:
```
kubectl -n prober get pods -l app=synthetic -o jsonpath='{.items[*].metadata.name}'
kubectl logs prober-apac-3 --tail=200
```
jordan: logs show repeated `HTTP/1.1 503` and upstream `connection reset by peer`, and many `429` from edge-proxy
lee: firewall and LB look fine. edge-proxy is returning 429 due to burst from probers
maria: applying emergency throttle: set fanout to 25% to reduce probe storm
maria: patching prober config (quick curl):
```
curl -X PATCH https://prober-config/api/v1/config -d '{"fanout_percent":25}'
```
sam: confirmed patch rolled to apac clusters (3/3) — propagation ~30s
pagerduty-bot: Incident acknowledged by sam
pagerduty-bot: Suppression rule applied to collapse duplicate alerts (dedupe by probe_id)
anika: suppression in PD active — noise should stop while we investigate
jordan: after throttle, synthetic failures dropped from ~30/m to <3/5m window. promising trend
lee: rolling back the recent prober rollout flag that changed fanout default as a follow-up
sam: customer impact assessment: currently internal synthetic failures; small uptick in retries for a subset of mobile clients in APAC (investigating list of affected customers). will escalate if APM shows user 5xx rise
maria: created follow-up ticket PROBER-1423: revert v2.1 fanout change, add jitter and exponential backoff, and add PD dedupe rule in runbook
anika: updating suppression playbook and PD auto-squelch settings so future floods don't wake the whole rotation
jordan: attaching short log snippet for postmortem:
```
[2026-03-15T09:12:02Z] prober-apac-3 GET /health-check -> 503 (upstream: connection reset by peer)
[2026-03-15T09:12:03Z] prober-apac-7 GET /health-check -> 429 (edge-proxy rate limit)
```
maria: drafting postmortem notes: timeline, config diff, PD noise, mitigation steps, customer impact, action items. will circulate draft for review
sam: oncall handoff: i'll be available for 15m, handoff to jordan if still active
lee: monitoring shows stabilization for 25m. i'll keep an eye for 1h then close incident if stable
anika: action items summary: (1) revert prober fanout change (PROBER-1423) (2) add PD dedupe and suppression rules (3) update runbook for quick throttle toggle (4) add metric alert to warn before probe fanout change
maria: thanks team — excellent coordination. closing notes will be in the postmortem doc. :thumbsup:
